verdicts.reason: A squeezes the headline into a small block in the middle of the canvas, leaving big empty areas above and below. Its leading is cramped, it has an orphaned word ('not'), and 'the limit' runs into the edge of the small, cropped building strip. B has the same tiny building strip, a faint band across the full width and very tight leading (the 'y' descender touches 'not'). However, its large headline fills the portrait format with confident hierarchy, a clear right-aligned edge and no text sitting on the image, so it is the stronger resize, though it still needs work before shipping.
